content.title: Maker of Folgers Brews Tariff Relief for Coffee Drinkers
content.summary: J.M. Smucker said Tuesday that it is no longer considering raising prices on its supermarket coffee this winter, after the Trump administration rolled back tariffs on coffee and dozens of other foodstuffs and agricultural goods.  Smucker, which owns brands such as Folgers and Café Bustelo, had already raised coffee prices twice this year.  The Orrville, Ohio-based company said in August that it was likely to do so again this winter, as costs to import coffee beans increased further.
